title: rhodiola rosea var. oblonga
intro: Rhodiola rosea var. oblonga, commonly known as Arctic rhodiola, is a variety of the Rhodiola rosea plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Crassulaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include stress relief, improved mental performance, and enhanced physical performance. The therapeutic actions of Arctic rhodiola include adaptogenic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in reducing stress and anxiety and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola rosea var. oblonga include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in dietary supplements to support mental and physical health.
